svg.title: Layered ingress inspection and egress topology
svg.desc: Topology showing Front Door Premium, Application Gateway WAF v2, Azure Firewall Premium, a private Standard Load Balancer, application spokes, and NAT Gateway.

g.aria-label: global TLS and WAF policy: front-door to app-gateway
regional inspected ingress: app-gateway to firewall
allowed private flow: firewall to load-balancer
private service distribution: load-balancer to applications
explicit outbound path: applications to nat-gateway
governed egress inspection: nat-gateway to firewall
Service node: Front Door Premium WAF
Service node: Application Gateway WAF v2
Service node: Private Standard Load Balancer
Service node: Explicit NAT Gateway egress

svg.text: Global HTTP traffic crosses two WAF layers before private services, while Firewall and NAT Gateway make inspection and outbound behavior explicit.
